transcript.text: Hey! I'm Sam. I haven't read a book in like two years and I want to get back into it, a little every day

Hey Sam, I'm ZOH, and I'm glad you're here. I'll help you get better at one thing with a small step each day. Text "stop" anytime, and tell me whenever you want me to coach differently, like "chill out" or "push me harder". Getting back into reading after two years? Let's go! When you did read, what kind of books pulled you in?
thrillers mostly, I loved Gone Girl. what's the best one to start with?

looking that up 🔎

Gone Girl fans get pointed to 
The Silent Patient, a twisty psychological thriller
, and The Couple Next Door is another fast one with big twists. For getting back into the habit, I'd start with The Silent Patient, because short, punchy chapters make it easy to say "one more." How many minutes a day can you realistically give it?
evenings after 9, like 20 to 30 min. I've got a library card
Twenty to thirty minutes after 9 is plenty to get back into a thriller. Where do you picture yourself reading: in bed, on the couch, somewhere else?
